title: Senate language on historical exotic technology antecedents (Lockheed's basement)

tellings.quote: if you read the language in, you know, it's come out of the the Senate, you know, in order to mitigate the possibility of of foreign technology surprise, the US government must broaden awareness of quote historical exotic technology anticedants previously provided by the federal government for research and development purposes.

plain: Wording put out by the US Senate around 2023 says that, to avoid being surprised by foreign technology, the government 'must broaden awareness of historical exotic technology antecedents previously provided by the federal government for research and development purposes.' The analyst Matthew Pines quotes this language and ties it to talk that such material ended up with Lockheed, the big aerospace defense company, sometimes described as sitting in Lockheed's basement. Read his way, it would mean the government once handed unusual technology to private companies to study.
